meta.name: Harlan Coben's Final Twist
meta.description: Known for his twisting narratives and intricate plots, Harlan Coben guides audiences through gripping tales of murder and high-profile crimes. Each story is meticulously unraveled to reveal hidden truths. With exclusive interviews and never-before-seen archival materials, each episode provides an in-depth look at stories where nothing is as it seems.

videos.title: Billy & Billie Jean
videos.overview: When police find a couple murdered in their home, the investigation leads to Facebook. Detectives discover a bizarre cyberbullying conflict with a neighboring family and the covert involvement of a CIA agent driven by personal vengeance.

videos.title: Gambler's Debt
videos.overview: When Anna Mae is found stabbed in her home, detectives face a tangle of suspects and shifting motives. Each lead-casino nights, hidden debts, and even a fugitive linked to her family-seems to crack the case, until new questions upend everything.

videos.title: No Sign of Nancy
videos.overview: Popular wine country local Nancy vanishes from her property while hosting a wedding. Dozens of workers and guests are all suspects. But it will take months, sleuth detective work, and new technology to finally find the elusive culprit.

videos.title: Who Killed Joy?
videos.overview: A wife is found dead following a fire, but police learn that the fire wasn't the cause of her death.

videos.title: Shot in the Dark
videos.overview: At dawn, a wife wakes up to find her husband has been shot in the head while sleeping beside her.

videos.title: Betsy's Trust
videos.overview: When church-going mother Betsy Faria is found stabbed to death in her quiet Missouri home, police initially suspect suicide; suspicions arise when more dead bodies are found.

videos.title: A Mother's Crusade
videos.overview: For 18-year-old Bonnie Craig, what begins as a routine walk to the school bus takes a tragic turn when she disappears; Bonnie's body is found in the water near a trail, and with no signs of foul play police initially rule her death a hiking accident.

videos.title: Camilo's Secret
videos.overview: In 2011, two Miami businessmen disappear; when police connect the two missing-person cases, the investigation stretches from one man's tight-knit family into South Florida's business elite and the world of professional mixed martial arts fighting

videos.title: A Recipe for Murder
videos.overview: Beloved Portland chef Dan Brophy is found shot dead at the culinary school where he teaches; detectives dig into his world, uncovering an unlikely cast of suspects: students, colleagues, and mushroom foragers.

videos.title: Caught on Camera
videos.overview: When a young couple is found shot dead in a crashed car in Nashville, detectives dig through phone records and blurry security footage that lead them across state lines straight into a secret someone was willing to kill to protect.

videos.title: State Secrets
videos.overview: A former Arkansas state senator is found dead in her home, her body wrapped in a tarp; investigators begin to ask whether her political past made her a target.

videos.title: Blood in the Ozarks
videos.overview: A 22-year-old college student vanishes from her boyfriend's home in the Ozarks; a week later, her body is found off a remote highway, launching a case that would baffle investigators for years.

videos.title: Trouble in the Panhandle
videos.overview: When Pensacola private investigator Taylor Wright vanishes, police assume she left by choice; a trail of phone records and unanswered questions begins to unravel a darker story.

videos.title: Last Seen Online
videos.overview: When teenager Britney Ujlaky vanishes from Elko, Nevada, a mysterious cowboy's pickup truck sends police chasing shadows, and a community has to ask: how well do we really know the people we trust?
